O.title: Kuvuleka Kuhlola Kwetintfo Letintsha
O.shortDescription: Kuvuleka kuhlola kwetintfo letintsha kuchaza umphimbo wesitayela sekucabanga lesibonakalisa bantfu labacabangelako, labadalako kunebantfu labangatsi banekuhamba phansi, labavamile.
O.results[0].text: Sikhombisa sakho kuVuleka Kuhlola Kwetintfo Letintsha sisezingeni lephansi, sibonakalisa kutsi utsandza kufuna kuchaza ngetemibhalo. Labanye bakubuka utsi unephansi, unekukhumbula, futsi unekwemukela.
O.results[1].text: Sikhombisa sakho kuVuleka Kuhlola Kwetintfo Letintsha sisezingeni lephakathi, sibonakalisa kutsi utsandza setiko kodvwa uvuma kuhlola tintfo letintsha. Kufundza kwakho akusiko kodvwa akukacambeki. Kubanye bavuka kutsi unemfundvo lephakeme kodvwa akusiko kubati kahle.
O.results[2].text:
Sikhombisa sakho kuVuleka Kuhlola Kwetintfo Letintsha sisezingeni lephakeme, sibonakalisa kutsi utsandza tintfo letintsha,
kuchubeka, futsi kushintja. Unekufuna, ufaneka, futsi udala.

C.results[0].text:
Sikhombisa sakho ku-Conscientiousness sisezingeni lephansi, sibonakalisa kutsi uyatsandza
kuphilisana kwesikhatsi lesitako futsi wenta loko kufaka kahle nyalo. Umsebenti wakho uvame
kutsi ungacapheliswanga futsi ungangahlaliseki.
C.results[1].text:
Sikhombisa sakho ku-Conscientiousness sisezingeni lephakathi. Loko kusho kutsi wetsembekile,
uhlelisiwe, futsi ulawula kahle kutsi utawenta njani.
C.results[2].text:

lecacile futsi uyilandzela ngendlela. Bantfu bakubuka kutsi wetsembekile futsi uyasebenta kakhulu.

E.shortDescription: KuHlangana kubonakala ngekuhlanganyela ngetinhloso tekutibonakalisa ngaphandle.
E.results[0].text:
Sikhombisa sakho kuHlangana sisezingeni lephansi, sibonakalisa kutsi wena
ungumuntfu lonetimfanelo tekuvala, umntfwanekhatsi, futsi uthulile. Uyatsandza kuba wedvwa nemisebenti yekuhlala wedvwa.
Kutihlanganisa kwakho kuvame kuba kubangani labancane labakhashane kakhulu.
E.results[1].text:
Sikhombisa sakho kuHlangana sisezingeni lephakathi, sibonakalisa kutsi awusi
umuntfu lonetimfanelo tekubate kutihlanganisa noma lonetimfanelo tekuba mnandzi nalabanye. Uyatsandza sikhatsi sakho nebantfu kodvwa futsi uyatsandza sikhatsi sakho sewudvwa.
E.results[2].text:
Sikhombisa sakho kuHlangana sisezingeni lephakeme, sibonakalisa kutsi wena
ungumuntfu lonemphilo, lohamba-hambako, unemandla, futsi ulukhuni. Uyatsandza kuba ngetimo tekuhlanganyela nebantfu kakhulu sikhatsi.

N.title: KuNeuroticism
N.shortDescription: KuNeuroticism kuchaza intfo lekulungele kutsi utibonele tifo letimbi.
N.results[0].text:
Sikhombisa sakho kuNeuroticism sisezingeni lephansi, sibonakalisa kutsi umuntfu
utikhutsateleke kakhulu, unekuhlala phansi futsi akagudluki. Awukakholwa ngekutibona ngemoya loluhlaba kakhulu, nome ngetimo letiningi bantfu labatiphatsa kahle
njengesongelo.
N.results[1].text:
Sikhombisa sakho kuNeuroticism sisezingeni lephakathi, sibonakalisa kutsi umoya wakho
wekubona ngemoya unesilinganiselo lekuhlangana ne-bantfu labavamile.
Letimo letidzabukako naletikhatsatako titfuba takho kutsi uzevele, kodvwa uvame kutsi ulahle
letifundvo futsi ukhone kwenta kahle naletimo.
N.results[2].text:
Sikhombisa sakho kuNeuroticism sisezingeni lephakeme, sibonakalisa kutsi ulula
kudzabuka, nome ngetintfo letiningi bantfu lababona njenge-tingu-mphilo.
Bantfu bakubona wena ulula futsi unekuzwelana.

O.facets[0].text:
Kubantu labane-umboniso, umhlaba wemphilo
uvame kuba ngumtfombo wesandla netisebenti. Bantfu labatfola emaphuzu laphakeme kuleli zinga basebentisa imicabango njengesandla
sekuveta umhlaba lothokozisa kakhulu, lowente kahle kakhulu. Bantfu labatekutfole emaphuzu aphezulu kuleli zinga batfola nganyakato yonkhe kunemicabango.
O.facets[1].text:
Bantfu labatfola emaphuzu laphakeme kuleli zinga batsandza
buhle, nome buhle basiko noma bemvelo. Bantfu batsatfwa futsi bacinezeleka kubuciko
netimphilo temvelo. Abaphatseki ngeso lobuciko kodvwa labanye bangahle batfola. Emaphuzu lalinganisa kakhulu akukhombisi bubuhle, 
letitja temvelo, futsi atisemi kutisita emisebenti 
yekubeka ubuciko. Bantfu labatekutfole emaphuzu laphansi atihambi phambili ekumangaleni kwetintfo letibukekayo futsi atitsandzi kubuciko.
O.facets[2].text:
Bantfu labane-Emotionality banekuvuleka
kuzeva futsi batsandza imicabango yabo. Bantfu labatekutfole emaphuzu aphezulu kuleli zinga abatihloniphi
imicabango yabo futsi abatibonakali kahle kumicabango yabo.
O.facets[3].text:
Bantfu labatfola emaphuzu laphakeme kuleli zinga batsandza
kuhlola tintfo letintsha, bahambe tihlandla letikude, futsi batokholwa tiphupho letehlukene. Batfole kutsi kuphila emhlabeni kunetimo letishisa futsi banokuhle, futsi batsembe ematfuba lamasha. Bantfu labatekutfole emaphuzu laphansi kuleli zinga batsintfwa ngekubhadalela letishintjako futsi batsandza timfanelo letatiwako.
O.facets[4].text: Kuhlakanipha netintsandvo tekubeka ubuciko tiyimphimbo lebili letibalulekile, letikhanyako emntfwini wekuvuleka kuhlola kwetintfo letintsha. Bantfu labatfola emaphuzu laphakeme kuKuhlakanipha batsandza kudlala nemicabango. Banekucabanga kuvulekele letintfo letintsha nelabhalile, futsi batsandza kuphikisana ngetinkhulumo temicabango. Batfola ema-challenges ekucabanga njenge-Riddles, puzzles, naletipho temcoka wetinkhulumo. Bantfu labatekutfole emaphuzu laphansi kuKuhlakanipha batsandza kunakekela kutsi babhalile ngekufundza noma tintfo kunemicabango. Abatsandzi emano asecabanga asekucabanga njengetipho telitsemba. Kuhlakanipha akufanele kumetane nekutihlakanipha. Kuhlakanipha kusitayela sekucabanga, kodvwa akusiso sitayela sekucabanga setitalente, noko labatfola emaphuzu aphezulu kuKuhlakanipha batfola emaphuzu lalinganiselwa letipho teticala futsi batfola ngalokulinganiselwa kunebantfu labanetipho letiphansi.
O.facets[5].text:
Liberalism yengcondvo iyalelwa kutsi ulungele kutsi
uphikise authority, umtsetfo, naletintsandvo letivamile. Kulicinisweni laso lelimcoka, i-Liberalism yengcondvo ingaba ikhombisa kuhhosha kwetimilo temtsetfo, kutifela labaphikisi bemtsetfo, futsi batsandza kuhlukana, imbhangwandlala, nemtsetfo. Labo labasekela umtsetfo batsandza kulondeka futsi batfole kutsi indlela lencono kwekumelana neliciniso letibambelela kwemtsetfo. Liberalism yengcondvo kanye nekukholwa kwabopolitiki akufani, kodvwa kuyacaca futsi kuyachubeka ekukholweni kwetikholwa tabanye.
C.description:
Tivakalelo atisibo ngempela tintfo letimbi; ngetikhatsi letimfisha tibhala kunakekela kucinisa, futsi kwenta ngendlela yetivakalelo tekucala kungaba yimpendvulo lekahle. Futsi, ngetikhatsi tekudlala kungebati, kwenta ngendlela yetivakalelo kungaba kuhle. Bantfu labanemacembu lamakhulu etivakalelo bangabonakala ngabanye bantfu njengebantfu labajabulisa, labatfokota nabo, futsi balokutsandza kutsandzeka.

Noko-ke, kwenta ngendlela yetivakalelo kungaholela etinkingeni ngetindlela letinyenti. Letinye tivakalelo atikahambi kahle emphakathini. Tentiwe tekulawula letivakalelo letikahambi kahle atingenti nje kuphela kutintfo letehlukene emphakathini, kodvwa futsi tingaholela ekuphindziseleni kumuntfu lotsintfo letenziwe ngendlela yetivakalelo. Lenye inkinga naletivakalelo letilawulako kutsi tivame kutfola imivuzo masinyane kodvwa tinemiphumela lemingemihle yesikhatsi lesidze. Tibonelo tifaka ekhatsi kuhlanganyela lokungakanani lokuholela ekukhishweni emsebentini, kuhlamba umuntu lokuholela ekuphelelweni buhlobo lobubalulekile, noma kusebenta tintfo letidvaka letiholela ekubhujisweni kwempilo yomuntfu.

Kutiphatsa ngendlela yetivakalelo, nome kungenzi lokubhidliza kakhulu, kuyehlisa likhono lemuntfu ngekubaluleka kwetindlela letinyenti. Kwenta ngendlela yetivakalelo kuyenqabela kufundza kutindlela letinye tetindlela tekuphatsa, letitawube titiphakeme kunetivakalelo letentiwe ngendlela yetivakalelo. Kutsintfwa kwetivakalelo futsi kuvimbela bantfu ngesikhathi sempumelelo letidzinga kutibopha ngesigaba sesinyatelo noma tilinganiso. Timphumelelo temuntfu lotsintfwe indlela yetivakalelo ngako-ke tincane, tehlukanisiwe, futsi tingaphumeleli.

Luphawu lwekuhlakanipha, lolungahlukanisa bantfu nekhatsi lemakhulu futsi letifanele tinkhulungwane letiphakeme, kutsi kukhono kwekucabanga ngemiphumela yesikhatsi lesitako ngaphambi kwekwenta ngendlela yetivakalelo. Kusebenta kwekuhlakanipha kufaka ekhatsi kutiphatsa ngekugijima kulesikhatsi lesitako, kuhlelisa futsi kucabanga ngendlela kulesimo lesitako, futsi kulingela lokuhlakanipha ngekufutsekela tivakalelo letifushane letihambisana naso. Kukhombisa kutsi kuhlakanipha kubandakanya kulawula tivakalelo kugcwele kahle ngekutsi kufakela luphawu lwekuhlakanipha, liphawu lelinye leSigaba se-Conscientiousness. Kukhombisa kweluhlakanipha kusho kokubili kuhlakanipha nekubuka phambili.

Bantfu labatfola emaphuzu laphakeme ku-Conscientiousness bayevela kwabanye bantfu njengabahlakaniphe. Imvuzo ye-Conscientiousness lukhulu kubonakala. Bantfu labanemacembu laphakeme ekulawuleni tivakalelo bayevala tinkinga futsi babe netimphumelelo letiphezulu ngekucabanga kahle futsi batfutfukise. Batsi bavame kuhlonishwa ngulabanye njengabahlakaniphe futsi bathembekile. Kuloluhlakanipha batsi bangaba bantfu labalungiselela kahle kakhulu futsi bayisebenta kakhulu. Noko-ke, bantfu labanemacembu laphakeme kakhulu ekulawuleni tivakalelo bangabukeka njengabaphansi futsi abajabulisi.

Bantfu labangakalawuleki kahle tingahle tibe nemiphumela yato njengokwetfola kanye netibonakaliso tenkhanuko, kodvwa batsandza timphilo letifushane futsi bangete babizwa ngekutsi baphansi.
C.facets[0].text:
Kukholelwa Kutikhona kuchaza kukholwa emandleni akho
kutsi utawenta tintfo. Bantfu labatfola emaphuzu laphakeme bakholelwa kutsi banekhono
(letisebenta kahle), sifutfukiso, nekulawula kahle kutsi utawenta kahle.
Bantfu labatekutfole emaphuzu aphansi abatihluphi kutsi bayasenta kahle, futsi bangahle babe nemicabango yekutsi abaphatsi kahle imphilo yabo.
C.facets[1].text:
Bantfu labatfola emaphuzu laphakeme ekuhleliseni
bahlalisekile kahle. Batsi batsandza kuphila ngekuma-routine netikhatsi. Batenta
tincwajana futsi benta tihlelo. Bantfu labatekutfole emaphuzu aphansi batihlalise
kodvwa bahlukanisiwe.
C.facets[2].text:
Lelizinga libonakalisa emandla emuntfu kutiphatsa ngekwesive
nesibopho. Bantfu labatfola emaphuzu laphakeme kuleli zinga banemandla
ekutiphatsa ngetimfanelo. Bantfu labatekutfole emaphuzu aphansi batibuka kutiphatsa, emitsetfweni, kanye
nemitsetfo njengaletibhidliza. Bangabonakala ngulabanye njengabangenabuciko noma
banganakekeli.
C.facets[3].text:
Bantfu labatfola emaphuzu laphakeme kuleli zinga
bahluteka kakhulu kutfola umphumelelo. Intfutfuko yabo yekufuna kutsi bahlonishwe njengabaphumeleli ibagcina
batfutfukisa ekutsimbeni kwabo imigomo yabo lephakeme. Bavame kutsi
banemandla lakhulu ekuphila, kodvwa emaphuzu laphakeme kakhulu angaba ngematikhatsi kakhulu futsi ajwayele
imisebenti yabo. Bantfu labatekutfole emaphuzu aphansi bayawuthokoza
kutsi batfutfuke ngetindleko letincane kakhulu, futsi bangahle babukeke ngulabanye
njengabalulama.
C.facets[4].text:
Kutiphatsa Ngekwesive-loko labanye bantfu bakubita
kutsi kumandla-ekuchaza kukhono kutsi uhlale kunento noma tintfo letidzidzete futsi tekuphila letitindzima kuze utente. Bantfu labanemandla
ekutiphatsa ngekwesive bakhone kutinqoba tindzaba letidvubekile kuze batente futsi bahlale endleleni nome
batijabhile. Bantfu labatekutfole emaphuzu aphansi batsandza kuhlalele phansi futsi bakhombise kutsi baphumule
bavame kwehluleka kuphumelela nangabe umsebenti lowutsandza kakhulu.
C.facets[5].text:
Kukholwa kutsi utawenta kuchaza emandla ekucabanga
ngalokutawenteka ngaphambi kwekwenta. Bantfu labatfola emaphuzu laphakeme kuKukholwa
kutsi utawenta batsatsa sikhatsi sabo nangabe benta tinqumo. Bantfu labatekutfole emaphuzu aphansi bavame kutsi batsi bente tintfo letingcondvo tabo tingakhombisi kutiva emandla etindleko letincono futsi
tingahle tivumele tindlela letincono.
E.facets[0].text:
Bantfu labanobungane batsandza labanye bantfu ngekuvuleka
futsi bakhombisa tilwimi letinhle letivelele kwabanye. Batentela bungani masinyane futsi kulula kubo kutsi bakhe bungani lobusondzelene, lobunene.
Bantfu labatekutfole emaphuzu laphansi kuBungane abatishisi
futsi abatinetisi, kodvwa abatsi bahlasele labanye futsi babonakale bavalekile futsi bangahlonipheki.
E.facets[1].text:
Bantfu labatsandza kuhlanganyela batfole inkampani yalabanye
ngekujabulisa nekutfutfukisa. Batitsandza imimoya yema-crowds. Bantfu labatekutfole emaphuzu laphansi batsi batsintfwe kakhulu ngetimfutfo, futsi ngako-ke bavame kuhlanganyela, emasango etikhulu. Abatsi bahlale nabantfu ngekukhuluma kodvwa batfole
sikhatsi sakhe sokuhlanganyela sifushane futsi lesiphezulu semuntfu lonetimfanelo lephakeme kuleli zinga.
E.facets[2].text:
Bantfu labatfola emaphuzu laphakeme kuKutfutfukisa batsandza
kukhuluma bavele bavele, batfwale, futsi bahole imisebenti yelabanye. Bavame kutsi
babe baholi bemagumeni. Bantfu labatekutfole emaphuzu aphansi bavame kutsi bangakhulumi kakhulu futsi bavumele
labanye kutsi bahole imisebenti yemagumeni.
E.facets[3].text:
Bantfu labanemphilo bayahamba,
bahlala baphila. Batfole kakhulu, banemandla, futsi bayasheshisa, futsi
bahlanganyela emitimbeni leminingi. Bantfu labatekutfole emaphuzu aphansi kuleli
zinga batsi bahambe kancane futsi bakhululeke, bakhululeke.
E.facets[4].text:
Bantfu labatfola emaphuzu laphakeme kuleli zinga batsi batsintfwe
batsi batfole titfutfuko letikhulu tekwenta kahle. Batitsandza kukhanya lokukhulu
nekutihlanganisa lokukhulu. Batfole kutsi batsatse tingoti futsi batfutfuke.
Bantfu labatekutfole emaphuzu aphansi batsintfwa yimisindvo kanye nemtfutfuko futsi batfole
ekubhaleni kutfutfuka.
E.facets[5].text:
Lelizinga lilinganisa titfutfuko letinhle
nemicabango, hhayi titfo letimbi (letihlangene nesigaba se-Neuroticism). Bantfu labatfola emaphuzu laphakeme kuleli zinga bavame
kutsi batfole titfutfuko letinhle letinyenti, kuhlanganisa kujabula,
kutfutfuka, kuhlakanipha, nekutfokota. Bantfu labatekutfole emaphuzu aphansi abavami kutsi batfole letimfutfo letinhle, letiphakeme.
A.description:
Ngako-ke banemusa, banobungane, banesandla lesimhlophe, bayasita, futsi bayavuma kuhlanganyela intsandvo yabo nalabanye. Bantu lababekezelayo baphindze babukeke bantfu benephutsa kanye netsemba. Bakholwa kutsi bantfu bahloniphekile, bangenabubi, futsi bathembekile.

Bantfu labangabekezeli babeka intsandvo yabo yebuciko ngaphezu kokuhlangana nabanye. Ngesikhatsi lesinyenti abacindzeteli kwenandziswa imphilo yalabanye, futsi bangeke batsambe kutsi bente tintfo ngabeluto. Ngekwesinye sikhatsi kutsi labanye babaganga ngekutsi batfola imphandze yabo, kubangela kutsi batembele kwabanye, bangabukeki kahle, futsi bangabi nesihlangene.

Kubekezela kubonakala kutsi kunemphumelelo ekutfweni nasekuhlonipheni. Bantfu lababekezelayo bayathandzeka kunalabanye labangabekezeli. Nangabe kubekezela kungakabi kusita etimeni letidzinga tinqumo letimphumphu leticanekileyo. Bantfu labangabekezeli bangaba bochwepheshe labahlakaniphe kakhulu, baphekumtseleti, noma emajoni labahle.
A.facets[0].text:
Umuntfu lonetsemba leliphezulu ucabanga kutsi bantfu labanyenti
bancono, bathembekile, futsi banetinhloso letinhle. Bantfu labatekutsemba 
babuka labanye njengebantfu labaneletinye titfo, labanobuqili, futsi labangahle babekete.
A.facets[1].text:
Bantfu labatfola emaphuzu laphakeme kuleli zinga aboni
sidingo sekutsi babe nemoya wokuhusha noma wente bugedla nakahlangana
nabanye ngako-ke bangachubeka kahle, babone intfo ngelihlo letinyanga, futsi bavele basho bavele basho. Bantfu labanephasi kuleli zinga bakholelwa kutsi
kunekudingeka kwekukhwabanisa kanye nekubetela emphakathini kubudlelwane.
Bantfu bayawakhutsata kulula kakhulu kubona labatfola emaphuzu laphakeme kuleli zinga. Bantfu babona kutsi kunzima kutsi babangane labafanele labatfola emaphuzu laphansi kuleli zinga. Kufanele kubonakale kutsi labanephasi
abalinganiselwe noma bangakhombisi live; batfole kutsi banemfundvo letinhle, 
banganali bugedla, futsi babhace kakhulu ekutjeni labanye bangamemukeli sikhatsi sonkhe.
A.facets[2].text:
Bantfu lababekezelayo bata kufuna kusita labanye
bantfu bakhululekile. Ngako-ke, batsi bagcinele kutsi basite
labo labaswele kutsi bafinyelele kwetsembeka. Bantfu lababekezelayo
bakholelwa kutsi kwenta tintfo talabanye kuhlala kungumtfombo
wentelekeleka kunekutsi kube kuhlupheka. Bantfu labatekutiphatsa kahle kuleli zinga abatijabulisi ngokusita labo labaswele. Titfo tekusita tibonakala
kutinselelela kunekutsi kube ngetsembeka.
A.facets[3].text:
Bantfu labatfola emaphuzu laphakeme kuleli zinga
abatitsandzi timo tembambano. Batsandza kakhulu kunikela noma
kunika intsandvo yabo lephansi ukuze bahlale kahle nabanye. Bantfu
labatfola emaphuzu laphansi kuleli zinga banemphumelelo ekutfutfukiseni
labanye ukuze bafike tindlela tabo.
A.facets[4].text:
Bantfu labatfola emaphuzu laphakeme kuleli zinga abatitsandzi
kubeka kutsi bancono kunalabanye bantfu. Kwezinye timo lesikhatsi lesifanele
leli lihawu lisuka ekuntweni kwetihawu letiphansi noma kutsi
baba nekutihlonipha lokuphansi. Noko, bantfu labanephasi labanye batfola
kutsi kutihlonipha lokuphansi akutihlosi. Bantfu labanye labatsandza
kutsi babonele kutsi bancono futsi bancono kunalabanye bantfu babonakala
njengebantfu labatfukutselako nalabanye.
A.facets[5].text:
Bantfu labatfola emaphuzu laphakeme kuleli zinga
banesihawu futsi bayakhathalela. Batsintfwa buhlungu balabanye
bantfu ngekutsi babekhutsate futsi batsintfwe lusizi. Bantfu labatfola
emaphuzu laphansi kuleli zinga abatiphatsi kahle ngebuhlungu
bebantfu. Batikhukhulela kakhulu ekutenteni tinqumo tetimphilo
ngesisekelo seliciniso. Bakukhathalela kwetinhlawulo netetsembeko
kunekuhawukela.
N.description:
nganyeli kakhulu ngetimo tekuhlanganyela emphakathini. Kungenwa kwabo ngetimo tekuphilisana kute kuchazwa njengekubate kutibamba noma kudzabuka; lo introvert ufuna kutihlenga kancane kuphindze kutsi abe yedwa.

Loku kutihlalisa nalokuvala loku kwenta kutsi lo introvert abonakale ngatsi akanandzawo noma kuba netikhumba letinkhulu. Kodvwa, lo introvert lotsi utfola emaphuzu laphakeme kuhlanganyela atifuni labanye kodvwa utoba mnandzi nakahlaselwa.27:T80b,Bantfu labavulekile bayatsandza kufundza, batsandza buchwepheshe, futsi banebuciko. Batsi batsintfwe, bafaniswe nalabavalekile, batibonakalisa kakhulu emuvakashi wemitfunti yabo. Batsi bacabanga bente ngendlela yabo futsi bangahlanganyeli netinkhohliso tekubona. Bochwepheshe bavame kutfola emaphuzu laphakeme kuVuleka Kuhlola Kwetintfo Letintsha; ngako-ke, leli liciniso libitwa ngeKultcha noma KuCabanga.

Noko, KuCabanga kungahle kubhekiswe kahle njengeyinye intfo yekuvuleka kuhlola kwetintfo letintsha. Emaphuzu kuVuleka Kuhlola Kwetintfo Letintsha asalamana ngencane neminyaka yemfundvo nemaphuzu ematekelo lakahle ekutadisha kwetitalente temtsetfo.

Letinye letibonakaliso tekucabanga kuvuleka kubonakala ngekucabanga ngetimphawu netimfihlo letise kahle kakhulu kuleto leticambile tintfo letivamil
N.facets[0].text:
Simo se "fight-or-flight" sengcondvo yalabo labakhatsatekile
singahle sibe lula futsi sitivakale ngaso sonkhe sikhatsi. Ngako-ke, bantfu labaphakeme ku-Kukhatsateka batsi babone kutsi intfo lesongelako itawuhlala yenteka.
Bangahle batfutfumele ngetimo letitsite noma batsi basabe nje ngebantfu labavamile.
Batsi batsintfwe, bafutfumalele, futsi balukhuni. Bantfu labatekutfole emaphuzu laphansi ku-Kukhatsateka batsi bahlale baphansi futsi bangabi nesaba.
N.facets[1].text:
Bantfu labatfola emaphuzu laphakeme ku-Intfukutselo bazifutfumele nangabe
tintfo atihambi ngendlela yabo. Batsi batihlonipha kakhulu nalokufanele baphatseke ngendlela lelungile futsi batsi banemona nalokuvuna nangabe batsi batfolwa. Lelizinga lilinganisa intfo lekulungele kutsi utivele ulukhuni; noma umuntfu lotsi utibonakalisa intfukutselo nesihawu kutitfola kumuntfu kutsi uvumelana nabo. Bantfu labatekutfole emaphuzu aphansi ativuki futsi alukhuni ngaso sonkhe sikhatsi.
N.facets[2].text:
Lelizinga lilinganisa intfo lekulungele kutsi utivele udzabukile, utihawukele,
futsi udvudvutsekile. Bantfu labatfola emaphuzu laphakeme babonakala kutsi batisebenta ngetandla futsi batsi bacine bahlulwa kusungula tintfo letinsha. Bantfu labatekutfole emaphuzu laphansi abavame kutsi batfole letifundvo tekudzabuka.
N.facets[3].text:
Bantfu labatekutizwela batsi batsintfwe kakhulu
nangabe labanye batsi babuka. Kukhathalela kwabo ngekukhanjukelwa
nalokuphoxwa kubabangele kutsi batihawukele futsi bangabi nesikhatsi lesihle nabanye. Batsi
batjabuliseke ngekubukisa futsi batsintfwa ngekucabanga. Letetsemba labo kutsi labanye
batsi bababuke noma bababuke phansi tikulu futsi atekwati, kodvwa
kuhawa kwabo futsi kungabi nesikhatsi lesihle kungahle kube kuhlakanipha kwesiphrofetho sekutibonakalisa. Bantfu labatekutfole emaphuzu aphansi abavami kutsi batibone kutsi wonkhe umuntfu
utibuka futsi atibonele bona. Batsi abatisebenti kahle letimo temphilo.
N.facets[4].text:
Bantfu labatekubhadala batsi batfole kulangata lokukhulu futsi
tingatfukatseka letingahle temukela kunzima kutsi balahle. Batsi bavame
kutsi batfole letintfo letifushane futsi batfole umvuzo kunemiphumela yalesikhatsi lesidze. Bantfu labatekutfole emaphuzu aphansi abavami kutsi batfole letintfo letinkhulu, letingaholeli kubi futsi abatfole kutsi batilalele kutsi batifakele kakhulu.
N.facets[5].text:
Bantfu labatekutfole emaphuzu laphakeme ku-Kutifaka Emcabangweni batfole
kuhlupheka, kudvudvutsekela, futsi batifakele tintfo tenkhingo nangabe basengcindezini noma baphatsekile.
Bantfu labatekutfole emaphuzu aphansi batfole kutsi bahlale baphansi, banekuthembeka, futsi bacabange kahle nangabe baphatsekile.
